text:
No option can be put forward yet, because the £400k annual-salary limit was not assessable in this run.

- The comparison is **very low robustness** and rests partly on Olumi-supplied estimates, including onboarding load and hiring effects; it is a provisional model result, not validated evidence.
- The key unresolved issue is that annual salary spend is calculated from other factors, but the £400k/year threshold has no compatible measurement frame. As a result, salary-budget compliance was excluded from the comparison.
- The model also has no stated direction for the shipping goal, so it assumed that a higher goal value is preferable.

A current analysis needs the salary limit attached to a measurable part of the model before this constraint can be tested.
